informal_statement: Applying the inverse to the area of a valid angle recovers that angle.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At MorgansArcFunction.lean:259-266, the source contract is `lemma θOf_area {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo 0 π) : θOf (area θ) = θ`. The unit-chord normalized area and arc length are constructed on 0 < theta < pi. The inverse is used geometrically only at positive area; its explicit totalization is not confused with an inverse outside that domain.
